additional_info.subject: ID0443153-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / S9 313882469001]Charger issue CRM:02681000608
additional_info.body:
Hello Lara, good afternoon. I hope yoiu are doing well.
I apologise in the delay, we have a surge of tickets.
The errors from 1/Aug at around 8am it's related to a Reboot coming from your backend:
For the error around 4:20pm, the error is reported wrongly. The session is finished completely well but when we are stopping the session we send a "E" state which is the SECC restarting the process, in this case it got reported wrongly.
For the rest of the errors it had a timeout and recovered <1sec after, this should be noticed on the StatusNotification. For this error I would like to request you to proactively check if this error occurs during a charging session.
I will convey this information to the regional team and have them troubleshoot it.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0443153-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / S9 313882469001]Charger issue CRM:00315002919
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues, ms. Lara is complaining that she is receiving several SECC no communication for 750ms which is showing up in the backend.
DC1: SECC: no communication for 750ms
From my perspective, this has never occurred during charging and it is resolved after 1sec. So it recovers from the error immediately after it happens.
Here, we need to make sure that the Ethernet cable is properly attached, you can trial swapping the Ethernet from DC1 to DC2 to make sure it's the cable, if it doesn't work, we should try replacing it and see if it's fixed.
This is a completely low priority ticket, if she finds that it happens during charging, then it is high priority.
You have my recommendation to order KF12
